title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Destiny Board Traveler
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify (RA notes are for the EU release): the four players' Life Points on the board HUD (red 4000, blue 3800, green 3750, yellow 4000) are u16s 0x10 apart from 0x02023AF8

rows: roll, move, land on spaces; Life Points and stars

widgets.text:
Board game with the Yu-Gi-Oh! cast: roll the die, move, and claim spaces with monster cards
Each player has Life Points; duels on spaces are decided by monster ATK/DEF

Land on monster spaces to duel; spells change the board
Cards include monsters, spells and traps from the real card game (e.g. Sakuretsu Armor, Archfiend's Roar, Dice Re-Roll, Contract with the Abyss)
Spells like Dice Re-Roll change your movement; traps punish opponents landing on your spaces

Monsters fight automatically by ATK/DEF
Duels on a space compare monster stats; place strong monsters on spaces many players pass
Keep a trap for the space in front of the leader

Several board maps
Several boards; characters unlock as you win (Yugi, Joey, Kaiba, Mai, Mokuba, Yami Yugi, Yami Bakura and others)

Cards collected from spaces
Your hand of cards; draw more by passing certain spaces

Card list
Card list grows as you play boards
Card list grows as you play; unlock more characters

Boards cleared, wins
Wins per board; unlock all characters
Win boards to unlock characters and cards

notes: player order in RAM: red, blue, green, yellow (the HUD shows red/green on top, blue/yellow below); each player starts with 4000 LP here
